title: Canonical proper/open comparison through integral quotient coordinates
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its compatible norm, and the lifted integer ring and uniformizer of [def-pur-adic-exceptional-system-realization]. For a compactification $c=(X\xrightarrow j\bar X\xrightarrow gY)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], let $C_T$ be the exact ordinary quotient-coordinate equivalence from coefficient-sequence modules to strict pro-etale systems, and also its exact derived equivalence. Let $S,G,H,D$ be the Brown finite-evaluation and site-transport data of [lem-pur-brown-tower-finite-site-comparison], with $F_D=D.\mathrm{compact}.\mathrm{functor}$. Let $F_{\rm seq}=J_jR_g$ be the existing ringed-sequence-site systemSupport of [def-pur-semilinear-compact-support-coefficient-transport]. All categories and localizations are ordinary unbounded derived categories [lem-pur-coefficient-system-derived-comparison].

Define the canonical natural isomorphism $\beta:C_XF_D\simeq F_{\rm seq}C_Y$ as the proper/open paste of the following uniquely normalized data. First, the ordinary direct-image comparisons for $j,g$ are identity on every underlying section, after the strict-system rightEvaluation and rightUnderlying isomorphisms. The ordinary inverse-image comparison for $j$ is their adjunction transpose through $C_T$. The ordinary extension-by-zero comparison is its transpose under the two extension/restriction adjunctions, retaining the actual Hom formula. Its derived comparison is fixed by the exact termwise factorization on every complex. The proper derived comparison is fixed by the actual universal right-derived unit, after the ordinary direct-image comparison and the coordinate localization factorization. There exists exactly one package satisfying these equations; beta is its derived open comparison whiskered by the proper direct image followed by its derived proper comparison whiskered by $J_j$. Every other package satisfying the same equations gives this same beta. No arbitrary endpoint isomorphism, automorphism twist, or selection of levelwise derived lifts enters the definition.

source.place: Outer Hom comparisons and final unit/counit paragraph; canonical comparison specified by Zheng Constructions 4.1 and 5.15, Lemma 4.10, and the universal-unit characterization in integralExceptionalComparison_characterization.

proof.text: Obtain the unique Ordinary comparison B, then the unique Derived extension R over B. The pair (B,R) is a Normalized record. Any other record has ordinary field equal to B; substitute that equality, then use uniqueness of the derived field over B. This proves normalized_existsUnique by actual dependent record equality.

Define normalized by the uniquely determined package and beta by its prescribed proper/open paste. For any B, apply uniqueness in normalized_existsUnique to get B=normalized, substitute, and use reflexivity for the two pastes.

proof_origin: Q4: ordinary/derived decomposition of the existing normalization argument, with dependent-record assembly and beta characterization proved in Lean. Both geometric comparison constructions remain named obligations.
